name: DropdownMenu
description: A dropdown menu shows a list of actions or options when people press a button. It keeps secondary actions out of the way until needed and closes after a choice.
whenToUse: For a set of actions that don’t all fit on screen, e.g. a “More” menu on a card.
For view options such as sort order or visible columns.

whenNotToUse.text: To choose a value in a form.
When there are only one or two actions.

anatomy.name: Trigger
anatomy.description: The button that opens the menu.

anatomy.name: Menu
anatomy.description: The panel with the items; it stays inside the viewport.

anatomy.name: Group label
anatomy.description: Optional heading for a group of items.

anatomy.name: Item
anatomy.description: An action or option, with optional icon and shortcut hint.

values.meaning: Destructive actions such as Delete; place them last, after a separator.

states.name: Open
states.meaning: The menu shows below the trigger.
states.trigger: Trigger pressed, or Enter / Space / Arrow Down on it.

states.name: Highlighted
states.meaning: The item under the pointer or keyboard.

states.name: Checked
states.meaning: A checkbox or radio item is on.

states.name: Disabled
states.meaning: The item can’t be used right now.

behavior.text: Arrow keys move between items, typing a letter jumps to a matching item, Enter or Space chooses it, Escape closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.
The menu closes after an item is chosen, on Escape, or when clicking outside.
Opens below the trigger and flips or shifts to stay in the viewport; set align to "end" to align with the trigger’s end edge.
The menu renders at the end of the page but keeps the theme of the ThemeProvider it opened from.
Alignment, submenus and arrow keys follow the reading direction.

content: Start item labels with a verb: “Duplicate”, “Move to…”, “Delete”.
Use an ellipsis (…) when an item needs more input before it happens.
Group related items and put destructive ones last.

guidelines.do: Give the trigger a clear label or an icon with an accessible name.
guidelines.dont: Use an unlabelled “…” icon with no name.
guidelines.why: People and screen readers need to know what the menu holds before opening it.

guidelines.do: Put destructive items last, after a separator, in the danger variant.
guidelines.dont: Mix Delete in among everyday actions.
guidelines.why: Separating risky actions prevents accidental clicks.

guidelines.do: Keep menus short: about seven items or fewer.
guidelines.dont: Put long lists or forms inside a menu.
guidelines.why: Long menus are hard to scan; use a dialog or page for complex choices.

accessibility.role: button (trigger) with aria-haspopup="menu", and a menu with menuitem, menuitemcheckbox and menuitemradio items (Radix).

keyboard.action: Opens the menu from the trigger and focuses the first item.
Jumps to the next item starting with that letter.
Closes the menu and returns focus to the trigger.

aria.when: Set on checkbox and radio items.
They’re visual hints; labels carry the meaning.

accessibility.focus: Focus moves into the menu when it opens and back to the trigger when it closes.

wcag.how: Everything works from the keyboard, per the WAI-ARIA menu button pattern.
Focus returns to the trigger after closing.
Items pass 4.5:1 at rest and highlighted, in every theme.
Menu, items and checked states are exposed.

notes: Shortcut hints are shown only; wire the actual keyboard shortcuts in your app.

examples.title: Actions menu
examples.code:
import { Button, DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem, DropdownMenuSeparator } from '@ds/react';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <Button appearance="outline" variant="secondary">Options</Button>
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={duplicate}>Duplicate</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuItem onSelect={archive}>Archive</DropdownMenuItem>
    <DropdownMenuSeparator />
    <DropdownMenuItem variant="danger" onSelect={remove}>Delete</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>

examples.title: Sort order
examples.description: Radio items for one exclusive choice.
examples.code:
import { DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuLabel, DropdownMenuRadioGroup, DropdownMenuRadioItem, Button } from '@ds/react';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button appearance="outline">Sort</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent>
    <DropdownMenuLabel>Sort by</DropdownMenuLabel>
    <DropdownMenuRadioGroup value={sort} onValueChange={setSort}>
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="newest">Newest</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
      <DropdownMenuRadioItem value="price">Price</DropdownMenuRadioItem>
    </DropdownMenuRadioGroup>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>

examples.title: Icon trigger
examples.description: An IconButton trigger with an accessible name.
examples.code:
import { IconButton, DropdownMenu, DropdownMenuTrigger, DropdownMenuContent, DropdownMenuItem } from '@ds/react';
import { Ellipsis } from 'lucide-react';

<DropdownMenu>
  <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
    <IconButton icon={<Ellipsis />} label="More actions" appearance="ghost" variant="secondary" />
  </DropdownMenuTrigger>
  <DropdownMenuContent align="end">
    <DropdownMenuItem>Rename</DropdownMenuItem>
  </DropdownMenuContent>
</DropdownMenu>

related.relation: Use to choose a form value.

changes: Replaces Dropdown: a Radix menu with trigger, keyboard navigation, typeahead and focus return.
Labels, separators, checkbox and radio items, submenus, shortcuts, danger items.
Portaled menus keep the theme of their ThemeProvider; compact density padding fixed (was -4px).

components.name: DropdownMenu
components.description:
A menu of actions or options that opens from a button. Arrow keys move through items,
typing jumps to an item, Escape closes it and focus returns to the trigger.

components.name: DropdownMenuTrigger
components.description:
The element that opens the menu. Use asChild with a Button so the trigger keeps its
styling: `<DropdownMenuTrigger asChild><Button>Options</Button></DropdownMenuTrigger>`.

components.name: DropdownMenuContent
components.description: The menu panel. Positions itself next to the trigger and stays inside the viewport.

sideOffset.description: Distance from the trigger in px.

components.name: DropdownMenuItem
components.description: An action. Use onSelect to run it; the menu closes afterwards.

variant.description: `danger` for destructive actions such as Delete.

icon.description: Icon before the label. Hidden from screen readers.

shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end, e.g. "⌘D". Only a hint; wire the shortcut yourself.

components.name: DropdownMenuCheckboxItem
components.description: An option that can be turned on or off independently.

shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end, e.g. "⌘D". Only a hint; wire the shortcut yourself.

components.name: DropdownMenuRadioGroup
components.description: Groups radio items so only one can be selected.

components.name: DropdownMenuRadioItem
components.description: One exclusive option inside a DropdownMenuRadioGroup, e.g. a sort order.

shortcut.description: Keyboard shortcut hint shown at the end, e.g. "⌘D". Only a hint; wire the shortcut yourself.

components.name: DropdownMenuLabel
components.description: A heading for a group of items. Not interactive.

components.name: DropdownMenuSeparator
components.description: A line between groups of items.

components.name: DropdownMenuSub
components.description: A nested menu. Contains a DropdownMenuSubTrigger and a DropdownMenuSubContent.

components.name: DropdownMenuSubTrigger
components.description: The item that opens a nested menu (with the right arrow key, hover or click).

icon.description: Icon before the label. Hidden from screen readers.
